# City Center Barbershop & Salon Amsterdam

> City Center Barbershop is a top-rated grooming parlour and hair salon located directly at Stationsplein 41M, 1012 AB Amsterdam (inside Amsterdam Centraal station). Specializing in modern skin fades, classic scissor haircuts, beard styling, hot towel razor shaves, and keratin treatments for gentlemen and ladies.

## Core Information
- **Business Name**: City Center Barbershop & Salon
- **Address**: Stationsplein 41M, 1012 AB Amsterdam, Netherlands (inside Amsterdam Centraal)
- **Phone**: +31 6 87999814 / +31 20 221 4454
- **Email**: info@citycenterbarbershop.nl
- **Rating**: 4.9/5 stars (550+ verified Google & Fresha reviews)
- **Opening Hours**: Monday to Sunday, 09:00 - 20:00 (Open 7 days a week, Walk-ins & Appointments welcome)

## Service Menu Overview
- **Heren Knippen / Men's Haircut**: Classic scissor cut or clipper trim tailored to head shape with neckline finish.
- **Skin Fade / Overloop**: Precision low, mid, high, or burst fade with seamless graduation.
- **Baard Trimmen / Beard Sculpting**: Hot razor detailing, shape alignment, beard oil treatment, and hot towel pampering.
- **Combi Knip & Baard / Haircut + Beard Combo**: Complete head and facial grooming signature package.
- **Hot Towel Shave / Traditioneel Scheren**: Traditional Italian straight-razor shave with soothing essential oils.
- **Haar Wassen & Föhnen**: Invigorating scalp massage, shampoo, conditioning, and blow-dry styling.
- **Dames / Ladies Styling & Keratine**: Women haircut, balayage color styling, and keratin hair smoothing treatment.
